notes: cics-crucible pseudo-conversational / pc-return-channel (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): RETURN TRANSID CHANNEL (PCRCA) and the PCRCL it links: a channel carried, changed, and a RETURN CHANNEL below the top logical level. Each scenario is one task; the crucible's multi-turn flows are restated one scenario per leg, each carrying the COMMAREA or channel the previous leg returned. The oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs. The case is entered as a LINKed program ("linked": true): the det service of a channel program has no handleTransaction facade, so the top-level RETURN TRANSID entry is not driven as such.

scenarios.name: carry
scenarios.why: mode C: PUT CONTAINER in channel PCCHAN, RETURN TRANSID(PC62) CHANNEL

scenarios.name: modify
scenarios.why: mode M: the container replaced and the channel returned

scenarios.name: link-level2
scenarios.why: mode L: LINK to PCRCL, whose RETURN CHANNEL is below the highest logical level (INVREQ), then it goes on

scenarios.name: no-mode
scenarios.why: a mode no WHEN names: RETURN
